hardware_identity: A100 PCIe and SXM4 are separate variants. Profiles also preserve observed GPU model, driver and host topology. SXM4 has only three supplementary checks; single H200 has only the requested 2K T2I check.
latency: HTTP POST through complete PNG/base64 response; warmed service; PE and client persistence excluded.
limits: 600 seconds per generation including warmup; three measured seeds at most. Historical over-limit results remain labeled.
archive: Only SHA256-verified archived originals are eligible as measured samples.
one_k: 1024-square output uses a 2048-square internal generation canvas under the local default, then resizes.
api_scope: Official API-supported input/output shapes, measured on the open checkpoint in vLLM-Omni. Hosted prompt enhancement and Highspeed internals are not part of these measurements.
quality: PNG integrity is verified. Timing completion does not establish semantic quality; reviewed examples are presented separately.
